title: Why do onions make you cry? #shorts
description:
Slicing an onion starts an enzyme reaction that releases a volatile eye irritant. This animation follows that irritant from the cut cells to your eyes.

Sources: Imai et al., Nature (2002), https://www.nature.com/articles/419685a and Løkke et al., Sensors (2012), https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC3571771/

Narration uses a synthetic voice.

scenes.say: Why do onions make you cry?
Cutting breaks cells. Enzymes form an eye irritant.
Its vapor reaches your eyes, triggering tears.
